label: Month of Eligibility
description:
Denotes the year (four-digit) and month (two-digit) during which the Medi-Cal beneficiary was eligible for Medi-Cal.

YYYY-MM (e.g., 2016-01 is January 2016)

label: Zip Code
description: Identifies Medi-Cal beneficiaries' residential five-digit zip code. Beneficiaries with invalid or out-of-state zip codes are represented by blank Zip Codes.

label: Sex
description:
Identifies the Medi-Cal beneficiary's sex.

M (Male)

F (Female)

label: Total Eligibles
description: The total number of individuals certified eligible for the month of eligibility. Certified eligibles are those beneficiaries deemed qualified for Medi-Cal by a valid eligibility determination, and who have enrolled into the program. This classification excludes beneficiaries who have not met a monthly share-of-cost obligation.

label: Annotation Code
description:
Code for type annotation. 

1= suppressed due to small number

label: Annotation Description
description: Description of Annotation for COUNT columns.

Certified eligible counts with a status of “P” are preliminary and subject to change. A specific month’s eligibility count is considered complete for statistical reporting purposes 12 months after the month’s end and indicates a status “F” for final.

P (Preliminary)

F (Final)

label: Date of Data
description: Date that data was pulled from the DHCS Management Information System/Decision Support System (MIS/DSS) data warehouse.
